title: Tech leaders favoured by hedge funds last month, Hazeltree says
title_zh: Hazeltree 表示，上个月科技龙头受到对冲基金的青睐
summary: Hedge funds stuck to their holdings in companies with ‌strong fundamentals in April, particularly technology ‌and semiconductor stocks, according to a report on Wednesday ​from data platform Hazeltree, in a month when the S&P 500 jumped over 10%.
summary_zh: 根据数据平台 Hazeltree 周三的一份报告，对冲基金在 4 月份坚持持有基本面强劲的公司，尤其是科技股和半导体股票，而标准普尔 500 指数在一个月内上涨了 10% 以上。

title: Goldman Sachs set to be named lead left underwriter for SpaceX IPO, source says
title_zh: 消息人士称，高盛将被任命为 SpaceX IPO 的首席左承销商
summary: May 19 () - Goldman Sachs is expected to secure the much-coveted lead left position in Elon Musk's rocket and satellite maker SpaceX's ‌initial public offering, a source familiar with the matter told  ‌on Tuesday.
summary_zh: 5 月 19 日 - 一位知情人士周二透露，高盛预计将在埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的火箭和卫星制造商 SpaceX 的首次公开募股中获得令人垂涎的左翼领先地位。
